title: plocama kandaharensis
intro: Plocama kandaharensis, commonly known as Kandaharene plocama or Kandahare plocama, is a species of flowering plant in the family Rutaceae. It is valued for its medicinal properties, particularly in traditional medicine, where it is used to treat various health issues. The plant is known for its health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as wound healing and the reduction of fever. The bioactive constituents of Plocama kandaharensis include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
